liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Feel Like a Stranger /** (2 reviews): Singled out as a tremendous performance in a high-energy show; The opener rocked, according to a listener at their very first show [18][20]
- **Help on the Way** (2 reviews): The Help on the Way, Slipknot!, Franklin's Tower triplet is played tightly, with clean transitions; The Help on the Way, Slipknot!, Franklin's Tower sequence is called a definite highlight [15][17]
- **Little Red Rooster /** (1 review): Praised as tremendous, part of a very hot show [18]
- **Deal** (1 review): Deal closing the first set rocked [20]
- **Iko Iko** (1 review): Short encore Iko Iko, with Jerry's phrasing outstanding and his voice strong and direct [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1983-06-28.142395.beyerm201.holbrook.flac2448** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 164 min [1]. Said about its sound: Less than ten seconds of music were missed at the transition into Sugar Magnolia [1]
- **gd83-06-28.sennheiser.hogan.3593.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 21 songs; 158 min; rated 4.88/5 by 17 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer considers the recording's sound quality fantastic; Good sound for an audience recording; Rated as a very good audience recording of a fun, well-played show [15][16][17]
- **gd1983-06-28.149921.akg460B.ck61.analog4011.flac24192**: source not stated; 21 songs; 157 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [4]
- **gd1983-06-28.142394.beyerm201.holbrook.flac1644**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 164 min [2]

## Around the show

- A helicopter landed close to the listener in the lot, and Jerry stepped out, smiled and waved at them [14]
- Jerry sounded like he was struggling here, though still great, while Bobby pushed the band along [19]
- Speaker stacks sat on the sidewalk between lawn and pavilion, with people dancing two feet from them [20]
- Jerry arrived by helicopter landing very near fans and waved right at them [22]
- Poplar Creek, in Hoffman Estates, was a smaller outdoor amphitheater, a different venue from World Theater in Tinley Park [23]
- Listener had attended the previous Poplar night, then went dancing in Chicago and came back without sleep [25]
- Felt ill, nearly got ejected for struggling to stand in set one, and was briefly struck blind at intermission [25]
- Uploader attended both nights and says this was the second of two Poplar Creek shows [4]
- Calls it a solid show, typical of the end-of-summer east/midwest tours such as Alpine and Oxford [14]
- Many shows from this era had sloppy segues, but here they are very tight [15]
- Reviewer thinks this energetic show is underrated and rarely heard by fans [18]
- Says Bobby was the driving force in 1983 and the band sounded worse than the previous year [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-06-28.142395.beyerm201.holbrook.flac2448**: taped by Tom Pinney & Kyle Holbrook and Executive Crew; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: flac24/48 First GEN AUD: Beyer M201's X-Y 7'up > Marantz Superscope PMD420 Maxell UDXLII 90 >Cassette copy: (Superscope to Denon Dr330) [1983] > Maxell UDXLII… [1]. Also: Taper used extra heavy duty TDK MA-R90 metal-alloy cassette tapes [1]
- **gd83-06-28.sennheiser.hogan.3593.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB Senn 421's> Sony TCD5M w/ Maxell XLII dolby B encoded MC> DAT> CDR> EAC> SHN (w/seek tables appended) [3]
- **gd1983-06-28.149921.akg460B.ck61.analog4011.flac24192**: taped by Analog4011; transferred by Analog4011; source: Mics: Mics: AKG 460B with the CK1 capsules Recorder: 1981 TCD-5M Sony Cassette Pro Portable Location: Sec 100 Row C Seat 107 Cassettes: Fuji Metal Bias C90:… [4]. Also: AKG 460B analog source, archived at 24-bit/192kHz; taper sometimes paused between songs [4]
- **gd1983-06-28.142394.beyerm201.holbrook.flac1644**: taped by Tom Pinney & Kyle Holbrook and Executive Crew; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: flac16/44.1 First GEN AUD: Beyer M201's X-Y 7'up > Marantz Superscope PMD420 Maxell UDXLII 90 >Cassette copy: (Superscope to Denon Dr330) [1983] > Maxell… [2]
